independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG2 scope. Its only authored files are QA tests, harnesses and evidence (tests/qa/**, e2e/a20-bilingual-shell.spec.ts, e2e/support/qa-stack.sh, docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/**). The round-7 product changes (D-067: T-DG2-BE11, T-DG2-BE12 by backend-workflow-engineer) touch none of the qa-verifier harness files. Every result here comes from qa-verifier's own runs on a disposable clone of 90439483 under $TMPDIR, which was removed afterwards. The candidate tree's HEAD 36524e5 is one commit past 90439483 (the round-7 freeze: assignments, manifest, stages.json, none of them manifest files), and the recomputed candidate ID matches in both trees. During this run HEAD moved to 844fa08 (code-security-reviewer's auto-committed round-7 evidence and a round-8 assignment). qa-verifier did not open those files, and the recomputed ID afterwards was still ede1a936…16de with 532 files. The verdict was formed without reading any other reviewer's round-7 record.

checks_run.procedure: Investigate the two integration attempts that exited non-zero. Read the full logs, check for listeners on the port, read the kernel ephemeral port range, and reproduce the bind conflict in isolation.
checks_run.environment: sandbox shared network namespace; ports 55172 and 56402; Linux 6.18
checks_run.expected: the cause is identified, with or without a product cause; a non-product cause is raised as a finding and the run repeated
checks_run.actual: Both attempts stopped in with-pg.sh before vitest started: postgres 'could not bind IPv4 address "127.0.0.1": Address already in use' -> 'BLOCKED: disposable PostgreSQL did not start', exit 3. Nothing listened on the port afterwards. ip_local_port_range is 32768-60999, so both ports, and every harness default (54331/54340/54351/54361), are ephemeral ports. The isolated reproduction shows that a client TIME_WAIT socket on port P makes a later bind+listen on P (SO_REUSEADDR set) fail with EADDRINUSE. This is a harness cause with no product involvement, raised as F-DG2-310 (Low). Both runs were repeated green (run2b and cutf8-load on ports 56272 and 25702). It does not explain the orchestrator's D-067 in-vitest setup symptom.

summary: PASS with one new Low, non-mandatory finding, F-DG2-310: a test-harness port collision with no product cause. Full regression of candidate ede1a936 (532 files, source 90439483) in both locale settings. Every static check exits 0, and the contract has 161 operations. Unit tests pass 9/9 runs at 673/673 on Node 22 and Node 24, in both locales and under load. Integration ran 5 times per locale (one under CPU load each), every run 531/531 with 0 skipped: 19 migrations on UTF8, contract (161 routed), blank-text, encoding, invalid-character and framework-errors. With the QA suites included it is 571/571. Two attempts never started: postgres hit EADDRINUSE because the harness ports are inside the kernel ephemeral range, and a client TIME_WAIT can hold the port. This was reproduced in isolation and raised as F-DG2-310; both runs were repeated green. The D-067 symptom (one file failing at setup, 11 skipped) did not recur in 24 runs of framework-errors and admin, including 12 targeted loops. Product e2e passes 62/62 per locale, including Define→G2 and Design→G3 in EN and AR. The QA acceptance stack passes 114/114 per locale with server_encoding UTF8 logged. Axe finds 0 violations over 592 screens. qa-verifier's own R7 spec confirms the lone-surrogate refusal (UI localized in EN/AR, real server 400 at the pointer, nothing written, emoji/Arabic control accepted). It also confirms 7/7 router- and connection-level errors answer 400 problem+json over a real socket with the routed security headers. The registry, CI and Keycloak residuals (D-057/D-058/D-049) are recorded on their offline or config surfaces. qa-verifier grants no business approval, and product G1-G6 never implies DG7.
